verdict.rationale: Synthesia's documented Billing API lets you programmatically retrieve the workspace's current billing period and credit balance. That supports tracking spend after the fact at the balance level. Nothing in the evidence shows a cost estimate in credits or dollars before running a generation, or a per-video spend breakdown. Missing for 10: pre-generation cost preview, per-generation or itemized spend history, dollar-denominated cost visibility, in-app (non-API) spend dashboard, independent corroboration.
